outcome: Prevalence of urinary incontinence (UI) at 4 and 24 months postpartum
cohort: 1643 women from the EDEN cohort, recruited from two French university hospitals
finding: Between 4 and 24 months postpartum, UI remission occurred in half of the cases, and changes in UI were primarily associated with mode of delivery and subsequent pregnancy.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was associated with an increased likelihood of UI remission.
